universe.name: Universe
universe.description: A bounded demonstration catalog of the Solar System, confirmed exoplanets and five named galaxies. The spatial layout and procedural appearances are illustrations, not a measured three-dimensional model.

solarRegion.name: Solar Neighborhood
solarRegion.description: This local navigation region contains the Solar System and 15 additional confirmed planetary systems at archive-reported distances within 15 parsecs. It is a bounded selection of nearby hosts, not a complete census or a claim of shared physical interstellar-cloud membership. Other regions retain their IAU sky-constellation groupings.

nearbySelection.selectionNote: Additional single-star confirmed-planet hosts, ordered by their archive-reported distance, are selected from the pinned source pool only when absent from the existing constellation cohort. Complete eligible host groups are added after the Solar System without moving or replacing any existing system, planet or parent. This nearby selection is intentionally incomplete.

solarSystem.name: Solar System
solarSystem.description: The Solar System contains the Sun and eight planets. Planet sizes, distances, surfaces and orbital motion in this map are illustrative.

star.name: Sun
star.description: The Sun is the star at the center of the Solar System. NASA lists its effective temperature as 5772 kelvin and its mean radius as 695700 kilometers.

planets.name: Mercury
planets.description: Mercury is the smallest planet in the Solar System and the closest planet to the Sun.

planets.name: Venus
planets.description: Venus is the second planet from the Sun. Its dense atmosphere traps heat, making it the hottest planet in the Solar System.

planets.name: Earth
planets.description: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only world currently known to support life.

planets.name: Mars
planets.description: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun. Iron minerals in its surface material give it a reddish appearance.

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.description: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System. It is a gas giant, made mostly of hydrogen and helium.

planets.name: Saturn
planets.description: Saturn is a gas giant surrounded by prominent rings composed mostly of pieces of ice.

planets.name: Uranus
planets.description: Uranus is an ice giant with a rotation axis tilted by about 98 degrees. It is the seventh planet from the Sun.

planets.name: Neptune
planets.description: Neptune is an ice giant and the eighth planet from the Sun. It is the most distant of the eight Solar System planets.

galaxies.name: Milky Way
galaxies.description: The Milky Way is the galaxy containing the Solar System. This demonstration includes a bounded selection of its confirmed nearby planetary systems.

galaxies.name: Andromeda
galaxies.description: Andromeda, also called Messier 31, is a large spiral galaxy in the Local Group. This demonstration does not place confirmed exoplanets in this galaxy.

galaxies.name: Triangulum
galaxies.description: Triangulum, also called Messier 33, is a spiral galaxy in the Local Group. No planetary systems are included here in this demonstration.

galaxies.name: Whirlpool
galaxies.description: Whirlpool, also called Messier 51, is a spiral galaxy whose prominent arms contain star-forming regions. No planetary systems are included here in this demonstration.

galaxies.name: Pinwheel
galaxies.description: Pinwheel, also called Messier 101, is a face-on spiral galaxy. No planetary systems are included here in this demonstration.
